title: FOMC communications blackout begins (through 2027-10-28) — the October 2027 Consumer Confidence print falls INSIDE it
source: EST: derived this session from the Board's own stated rule and cross-checked against a decode this repo already holds. THE RULE IS PRIMARY AND RE-APPLIED, NOT INHERITED: federalreserve.gov's blackout-period policy states verbatim that "the blackout period will begin at 12:00 a.m. Eastern Time the second Saturday before a meeting ... if the Committee meeting starts on a Tuesday, the blackout period will begin at the start of the Saturday that falls ten days earlier", and ends at the end of the Thursday following the meeting's conclusion. The October 2027 meeting was read direct this session off federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm (HTTP 200, 164,831 bytes, 2026-09-06), whose 2027 panel gives "October 26-27" with no SEP asterisk. Oct 26 2027 is a Tuesday, ten days earlier is Saturday 2027-10-16, and the meeting concludes Wednesday Oct 27 so the window closes at the end of Thursday 2027-10-28. CORROBORATED INDEPENDENTLY by the decode this repo already carries: the fomc-blackout-start-2027-04-17 lane inflated and decoded federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/files/fomc-blackout-period-calendar.pdf on 2026-09-05 and recorded the 2027 shaded windows verbatim as "Jan 16-28, Mar 6-18, APR 17-29, May 29 -> Jun 10, JUL 17-29, Sep 4-16, OCT 16-28, Nov 27 -> Dec 9" -- a decode this session did not re-run and does not claim to have re-run. Its "Oct 16-28" matches this session's independent arithmetic to the day. The same arithmetic also reproduces all seven other 2027 windows from the fomccalendars panel alone, which is itself the check on the reading. Filed estimate because it is a firm rule applied to a TENTATIVE meeting date -- fomccalendars.htm states every 2027 date is "tentative until confirmed at the meeting immediately preceding it", so the promotion trigger is the 2027-09-14/15 meeting, not a better fetch. Discovered during the consumer-confidence-2027-10-26 initial research, checked 2026-09-06
notes: DISCOVERED during the consumer-confidence-2027-10-26 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-06). THIS IS THE FIRST BLACKOUT ENTRY IN THIS CALENDAR THAT ACTUALLY CONTAINS A TRACKED PRINT, and that is why it is proposed rather than skipped. The September sibling's parent proposal made an identical-sounding claim about the September print and it was arithmetically wrong: 2027-09-28 falls twelve days AFTER the 09-04 to 09-16 window closes. The October claim is right. 2027-10-26 lies inside 2027-10-16 to 2027-10-28, four sessions into the window, and it is FOMC day one. TWO THINGS FOR WHOEVER TAKES THIS ID. (1) THE CONFIGURATION IS THE EXACT MIRROR OF SEPTEMBER'S, AND BOTH ARE MEASURED NULL. In September 2027 the survey panel HEARS the decision while the release sits in clear air; in October 2027 the panel is Fed-DEAF (the last decision is 2027-09-15, and the panel runs about 10-04/05 to 10-19/20 on the editions' own stated cut-off lags) while the RELEASE sits inside the blackout. The CB lane measured the release-in-blackout channel directly for the first time this session by deriving every 2021-2027 window from the same rule: 23 of the 68 CB days in the tape window fall inside one and 45 outside, and the two are 0 of 9 across SPY/QQQ/XLY/XRT/AMZN/AAPL/XLF/TLT/VIX (SPY 0.921/0.788, p=0.8764, smallest AMZN 0.3574). Isolating blackout WITHOUT collision -- clean CB days inside a window, n=6, against clean CB days outside, n=45 -- is also 0 of 9 (smallest VIX 0.0872). That makes three Fed-transmission channels tested by this chain and three nulls. (2) THE WINDOW'S OWN CONTENT IS THE THING WORTH WATCHING, NOT ITS EFFECT ON THE PRINT. A blackout is the absence of Fed speakers, so what it changes is which OTHER voices move the tape during it -- and in 2027 this particular window also brackets the mega-cap October reporting cluster (this repo's earnings calendar puts MSFT, META, AMZN and AAPL inside the equivalent 2026 window). A lane taking this id should treat it as a speaker-silence marker for the corridor, not as a signal about any single release. Same channel caveat as every macro entry: symbols is empty and no house playbook is macro-keyed. Proposed as an estimate; nothing here licenses an entry.
